title: Shadow hunt
offscreen: In the evening, with a flashlight, make shadows on the wall with your hands and a toy. Does the one who gets closer to the light make the bigger shadow?

items.label: A shadow on the floor or the wall
items.say: Look for a shadow on the floor or the wall. Look at it closely: what shape is it?

items.label: The shadow of a chair
items.say: Now the shadow of a chair or a piece of furniture. Touch it with your finger: can you feel it?

items.label: The shadow of your hand
items.say: And the shadow of your hand. What happens if you bring it closer to the wall?

items.label: A toy that makes a nice shadow
items.say: Look for a toy that makes a nice shadow and bring it here.

items.label: A place with no shadow
items.say: Now a place where there is no shadow. Why do you think so?

items.label: A long shadow and a short one
items.say: Find a long shadow and a short one, and tell me which you like more.

intro.bo: {nome}, shall we go on a treasure hunt? You look in your own time, one thing at a time.
intro.pilu: {nome}, I'll tell you something to look for. Look carefully around you: treasures are everywhere.
intro.tango: Treasure hunt, {nome}! I'm coming too! ...No, I'll stay here. You look, slowly.

outro.bo: So many treasures, {nome}. Now each one goes back in its place, so we can find them again tomorrow.
outro.pilu: Every treasure goes back where you found it, {nome}: that's part of the game too.
outro.tango: What a hunt! {nome}, shall we put everything back? I'll... I'll keep an eye on it.
